text:
Alice Nguyen: Quick thread: we have 3 DB connection incidents in ~6 weeks. Before finalizing remediation, we need a comms decision (statuspage wording, customer summaries, and when/how we share full RCAs).

Samir Patel: Agreed. Two quick goals: 1) be clear on the public-facing wording so customers aren't left guessing; 2) create a predictable path for customers to request more detail.

Jia Li: Noted pattern: spikes align with nightly batch job start. I'll attach query snippets to the analysis doc after lunch. For comms, would prefer a short public line + an offer to provide detailed, redacted RCAs on request.

Elena Park: Security/legal input: fine with an "offer on request" approach. Conditions: require explicit consent recorded in Support ticket, apply redaction checklist by default, escalate to Legal for any unredacted log sharing.

Alice Nguyen: Proposal for final decisions here:
- Public statuspage blurb: one sentence, non-actionable, e.g. "Intermittent database connectivity impacted a subset of inference requests; mitigations were applied and monitoring continues."
- 72h customer summary (short, plain english) sent to impacted customers automatically where possible
- Full RCA: available to customers who request via Support; default is redacted RCA; unredacted on case-by-case + Legal approval.
Any objections?

Samir Patel: No objections. My addition: add a checkbox in Support form: "I want the full technical report (may include logs)" so consent is explicit. Also tag these incidents with `recurring-db-conn` so we can surface trend reports.

Jia Li: Love the checkbox idea. For the 72h summary template, suggestion: 3 bullets — (1) What happened (2) Who was affected (3) What we did + next steps. Keep it non-technical.

Elena Park: I'll draft the redaction checklist and the Legal escalation matrix. Timeline: checklist by Thu EOD, matrix by Fri.

incident-bot: Created tasks: INC-DB-2001 (72h template) assigned to Jia Li due 2191280000; INC-DB-2002 (support consent checkbox) assigned to Samir Patel due 2191340000; INC-DB-2003 (redaction checklist) assigned to Elena Park due 2191310000.

Alice Nguyen: Owners and deadlines recap: Jia (72h) Tue, Samir (Support flow) Thu, Elena (redaction) Wed. I'll coordinate customer outreach once 72h template is ready.

Samir Patel: For the recurring pattern detection, I'll add an automated rule: if 2+ incidents with the same `signature_hash` occur within 21 days, auto-create a mitigation ticket and notify Eng-Platform + Prod. Want to sanity-check threshold?

Jia Li: 21 days sounds reasonable for batch window issues. I'll include `signature_hash` examples in the analysis doc.

Elena Park: Security ok with auto-ticketing, as long as tickets are labeled and access controlled.

Alice Nguyen: Let's have a 20-minute sync tomorrow to review the statuspage sentence, the 72h template, and the Support checkbox copy. Availability?

Jia Li: 9:30

m PT works.

Samir Patel: 9:30 works for me.

Elena Park: I'll join.

Support Bot: Support form updated draft available at https://support.redwood/drafts/rca-consent (link preview).

Alice Nguyen: Thanks. I'll send the invite and add the agenda. After sync, we'll post the approved 72h note to affected customers and update the statuspage blurb.

Samir Patel: One more: recommend we retro-tag related postmortems with `recurring-db-conn` and set a monthly review for trends. I'll add that to INC-DB-2002.

Alice Nguyen: Great. If anything slips, tag me. We'll close this thread after the sync with final wording. :white_check_mark:
